arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Williams argued the prosecution clearly violated Brady principles.
Mr. Dreeben asserted the evidence of a group attack was strong and corroborated.
Ms. Rice noted the jury repeatedly deadlocked before returning a conviction.
Justice Alito questioned the consistency of the alternative perpetrator theory with trial defenses.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case involves two men convicted of a group attack. Prosecutors withheld evidence that could have supported an alternative perpetrator theory. the sides that brought the case claim this omission violated their right to a fair trial. The government argues the remaining evidence was strong enough to sustain the verdicts.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines the threshold for materiality in Brady violations. It determines when withheld evidence requires a new trial. The outcome affects the reliability of criminal convictions nationwide.
